results.title: Shaping a new era of resilience, innovation and shared prosperity
results.description: Viet Nam’s formal assumption of the APEC 2027 host role in Shenzhen, China, marks the beginning of a new journey for the country, bringing not only the responsibility of hosting one of the region’s leading economic forums but also an opportunity to shape cooperation priorities, build consensus and translate commitments into tangible outcomes.
